scientific_question: Does the pure activation-modulation component add held-out c_proj residual-write coverage after preserving the strongest static axes, under the same total 384x or 256x coordinate budget?

frozen_data_and_operator.target_isolation: Terminal same-run router and c_fc on both sides; terminal minus step-zero same-run c_proj is the only target action.

decomposition.static_operator: A0 is the parent beta=0 operator.
decomposition.coupled_operator: A1 is the parent beta=1 operator with gate (1+u)/sqrt(2).
decomposition.pure_modulation: Au = sqrt(2)*A1 - A0, exactly isolating the u(h) term without a new axis, seed, or beta.
decomposition.two_factor_384x: Fit factor 0 through A0 and factor 1 through Au; compare with factors 0 and 1 through A0.
decomposition.three_factor_256x: Fit factors 0 and 1 through A0 and factor 2 through Au; compare with factors 0,1,2 through A0.
decomposition.reason: The parent shows static recovery increasing by about 0.055 per added factor while the coupled modulation loses 0.087-0.097. Preserving all but one static factor tests whether Au contributes more complementary action than the static factor it replaces.

controls.router_occupancy: Record the already observed per-expert assignments; do not hide occupancy failure by pooling experts.

decision_rule.pass_all: Only if recovery, complementarity, stability, and occupancy pass may the direct-sum map enter a separately preregistered multi-phase shadow oracle; training remains unauthorized.
decision_rule.complementary_but_occupancy_fail: Close c_proj structure selection temporarily and repair router occupancy in a dense-expert control before any generated-expert test.
decision_rule.no_complementarity: Close activation-conditioned FHT modulation at this budget. No beta, rank, seed, or allocation sweep is allowed.
decision_rule.execution: Direct foreground polling; expected under five minutes and no watchdog unless observed runtime crosses five minutes.
